finding: DEAD and actively harmful — the breadcrumb prints 'Alt+↑ Parent' and 'Alt+↓ Child'. Neither navigates: ⌥↑/⌥↓ are bound to REORDER the selected element in the DOM, so a user following the printed hint silently moves their content.

Code binds ⌥↑ -> reorderElement(...,'up') and ⌥↓ -> reorderElement(...,'down') (useCanvasKeyboard.ts:261, 274); parent/child are the PLAIN arrows (ArrowLeft -> select(parent), useCanvasKeyboard.ts:286; ArrowRight -> select(firstChild), :298). The component itself prints '← Parent' / '→ Child' (CanvasBreadcrumb.tsx:168-169) under a comment saying those are the keys actually bound.
fix: Change the board's two hint labels to '← Parent' and '→ Child'.

finding: DEAD — four chords printed on the Insert submenu are bound to nothing, and two of them are bound to something else: ⌘⇧↑ / ⌘⇧↓ nudge the element one pixel, and ⌘⇧W / ⌘⇧U have no handler in the editor at all.

No 'w'/'u' key binding exists in editor/ (only rail/tabsConfig.ts:210, an unrelated rail letter).
fix: Either bind the four chords in insertActions.ts and render them, or strip them from the board — a printed chord is a contract.

finding: All four canvas 'Insert before/after/inside' commands silently do nothing when the chosen parent cannot accept a container — the placeholder factory returns null and every handler bails with a bare return, no toast, no state. Nothing on any board covers the outcome.

The sidebar path toasts for the same condition (useBlockInsertion.ts:158-169).
